messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands security block. A few prospects asked for clarity on data residency guarantees, KMS BYOK rotation behavior, and what audit logs we can hand off for Private installs. Can owners call out who’s doing what + short deadlines?

Ava (Security): I’ll own the BYOK rotation explainer and the audit-log retention proposal. Will need Platform for exact export formats and Legal for the customer-facing wording.

Diego (Platform): On logs: we can deliver NDJSON request dumps, metadata event streams, and flow logs. Default retention: 90d (full traces), 365d (metadata). Export API accepts S3/GCS destinations; will add EU-region examples.

Priya (Legal): I’ll draft the short legal blurb for BYOK and EU-only custody claims. Reminder: any "EU-only" promise needs region-bound KMS + region-bounded storage + DPA amendment.

Liam (Infra): For Private VPC checklist: I’ll produce a compact doc with CIDR guidance, flow log setup, and private DNS notes. ETA: 2015012600 (48h).

Nina (Privacy): We should offer a PII-redaction toggle on exports (default on for customer exports, off for auditor exports). I’ll draft rules for common patterns (email, phone, ssn-like).

Sam (Sales): Can we get a one-paragraph we can paste into RFPs about BYOK rotation and downtime? Prospect asked specifically.

Ava (Security): Short paragraph: "Redwood supports staged BYOK rotations using key aliases and an overlap window so requests can be served during rotation. Customers provide rotated keys; Redwood validates and switches aliases atomically to avoid downtime." I’ll refine with Legal.

Diego (Platform): I’ll publish sample CLI + API snippet for audit export to EU buckets and include a `--redact-pii` flag. ETA: 2015012780 (Fri EOD). Example CLI: `redwoodctl export-audit --job 42 --dest gs://customer-eu-bucket --redact-pii`

Priya (Legal): I’ll review Ava’s paragraph and the FAQ by 2015012840 (Mon morning). Also flag: retention >3 years needs Privacy sign-off.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2015012345 (access via SSO).

Jo Chen (CEO): Perfect. Please add owners + deadlines to the compliance workspace and ping me if exec unblock needed. I’ll check progress next Tues.
